description: Draw a design with AI. With reference ids (upload_design_reference) it recreates it closely and brief says only what to change; without, brief describes the design (what it shows, exact words, style). Uses 1 of the account's 20 free AI images a month (at most 15 a day); nothing is charged. Then poll get_generation_job until status is review. Only use images and text the person owns or may use (Toolbox POD Terms of Service).

colorCodes.description: Optional: the shirt color it is drawn for, usually one code

garment.description: A garment code: GD64, CC17, LS14, or one stocked for this account alone (list_garments)
